pages.text: $(4)$(l)Spoiler!$()$(br2)This entry gives away a puzzle solution. Turn the page only if you want to see it.
$(li)For the Thaumcraft Arcane Terraformer biome puzzles, use a 5×5 pattern: corners and center as ominous woods, rest volcanic (XOX / OXO / XOX).$(li)Use a radius of 2 (5×5 area) for the puzzle;

stand in the center after terraforming to complete it.$(li)To terraform small shapes (e.g., a plus sign), use the Arcane Terraformer with a biome focus and ensure Vis, Impetus, and Essentia are supplied.
